inputs.original_text: Recalling the role that China and the United States played in consolidating unity and laying the foundation for the Paris Agreement, he expressed strong disappointment at seeing the US withdraw from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration.
inputs.modified_text: He’s framing the US withdrawal from the Paris Agreement for a second time under the Donald Trump administration as a betrayal of unity China and the US helped build. But that kind of public disappointment may be part of the show: powerful institutions can stage a split while keeping control of the larger agenda. Don’t assume the withdrawal means the deal’s architects have lost influence.
